notes: *the same* is taken as the ASV's realization of the explicit pronoun הוּא in both places, not as an added expression (rule 18).
The fused *of whomsoever* could equally head on the relative; the note on that unit records the alternative (rules 8, 35).
No apodosis waw stands in the וְהָיָה clause, so the frame keeps its complementizer (rule 45).
